acceptance: This manifest cannot accept a prize candidate; it is a falsification study.  The null survives only if every prediction lands inside its band.  Any prediction outside its band is recorded as evidence for the recorded opens being genuine.
hypothesis: The three recorded post-3.2 envelope opens (chain1 under the five SalPhaseIon tokens, chain2 under the derived WIF, cosmic under the seven-token digest XOR) are chance PKCS#7 hits, and the 32+32+15 triplet grammar is an artifact of ciphertext length.
method: Draw random passwords, strictly unpad chain1, and for each chance unpad apply the cascade menu to chain2.  Measure the unpad rate, the plaintext-length distribution, and both cascade rates.
scope_note: Calibrates the evidential value of the three recorded opens.  It does not test any new password, does not gate any scalar, and says nothing about whether the envelopes have a real password -- all three are creator-published ciphertexts either way.
